method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 267, compilation date 27 August 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 79, 2026; register id C2026C00400, 12 volumes), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A05138.txt; rates from the Income Tax Rates Act 1986, Compilation No. 66, compilation date 1 July 2026 (amendments up to Act No. 50, 2026; register id C2026C00300), as deposited at ../../../income-tax-rates-act-1986/registers/source-bundle/C2004A03348.txt

checks.command: l4 run itaa-cases-business.l4 ; l4 run itaa-cases-cgt.l4 ; l4 run itaa-cases-income.l4 ; l4 run itaa-cases-super.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the individual taxpayer, for the 24 events of the WA cradle-to-grave lives that cite the Act: ss 4-10, 4-15 (taxable income, the income tax owed); Income Tax Rates Act 1986 s 3 ($18,200 tax-free threshold), Schedule 7 Part I (resident rates 2024-25 onward; no table for 2023-24 in the deposit), ss 23(2), 23AA (company rate); s 6-5; s 8-1; s 30-15 items 1-2 and (2), s 26-55 (gifts of money); ss 36-10, 36-15(2), 36-17(2) (tax losses); ss 61-110, 61-115 (Low Income tax offset); ss 61-155, 61-160 (working Australians tax offset, application year asked as a fact); ss 83A-25, 83A-30, 83A-33, 83A-35, 83A-45 (ESS upfront taxing and the start-up concession); s 355-100(1), (2) (small company R&D offset); ss 360-15, 360-20, 360-25 (early stage investor offset); ss 104-10(4), 110-36(1A), 114-10 (capital gain with indexation from 1 July 2027); ss 115-10 to 115-25, 115-100, 115-102 (discount); s 102-5 (one gain); ss 118-110, 118-150 (main residence); ss 152-10(1)(c), (1AA), 152-15 ($6,000,000 test); ss 128-10, 104-215, 118-60 (death); ss 290-230, 290-235; ss 291-20(2), 292-85(2); s 292-102; ss 294-30, 294-35; ss 301-10 to 301-40; ss 302-60, 302-140, 302-145, 302-195. Indexed caps, the indexation factor, cost bases and aggregated turnover are inputs. Left out: the rest of the Act (12 volumes), including Subdiv 112-E, Div 114 beyond the 12-month rule, Subdivs 152-B to 152-E, Subdiv 83A-C, Subdiv 30-DB, Div 355 beyond the rate, Subdiv 360-B, the bring-forward rule, Medicare levy and HELP (other Acts).
seat: the taxpayer: an individual Australian resident (in Daniel's life also the founder, shareholder and investor, who asks the company questions about his company)
